verdict.rationale: Finix's platform-payments docs show sellers can be onboarded, paid out, and platforms can take a monetization cut via customizable fees (finix-docs-9, finix-docs-11, finix-docs-12, finix-docs-25), which supports routing funds to multiple sellers and taking a platform cut. However there's no explicit documentation of a 'split' as a first-class API object that can be reversed or adjusted after the fact, or of splitting a single charge among an arbitrary set of parties in one transaction. Missing for 10: explicit split/transfer API object model, reversal/adjustment of splits post-charge, multi-party single-charge routing example.
